record_scope: Frozen implementation and prompt treatment for the Loreley QD arm in the matched Zstandard experiment. Outcome records and statistical analyses are stored separately.

target.name: Zstandard
target.goal: Improve single-thread Zstandard compression and decompression throughput at levels 1, 3, and 5 while preserving format compatibility, public behavior, compressed size, memory use, upstream tests, portability, and the frozen campaign contract.

each_inspiration: bounded distinctive trajectory relative to the base
prompt_context.checkout_semantics: Only the sampled base commit is checked out. Inspirations are supplied as text context; the coding agent edits the complete base repository.

agent.direct_sampling_parameters: No temperature, top-p, explicit model context-window, or direct model output-token override is recorded by the frozen planning/coding treatment; provider/runtime behavior is identified by the routes, Responses API, max variant, and Kilo version above.

warmup.history_rule: Each valid artifact-unique warm-up offspring enters descriptor history; the evaluated root is not a descriptor-history entry.
warmup.initial_archive_rule: When the fourth eligible state makes the projection fit possible, all eligible warm-up states are projected and considered for ordinary archive admission.

descriptor.repository_aggregation: uniform mean of eligible file embeddings
descriptor.archive_rebuild_source: records retained immediately before the refit; previously discarded records are not reconsidered

archive.epsilon_equivalence_rule: After sorting candidates by commit hash, skip a later candidate when every absolute per-objective difference from a retained representative is at most epsilon.
archive.epsilon_dominance_rule: The first vector epsilon-dominates the second when it is at least second minus epsilon on every objective and exceeds second plus epsilon on at least one objective.
archive.equivalent_representative_rule: Commit-hash lexicographic order deterministically selects the first retained representative.
archive.base_sampling: uniform occupied cell, then uniform retained member

batch_semantics.snapshot: All four jobs in a scheduling batch sample from one frozen archive snapshot.
batch_semantics.exclusions: Within the batch, already selected base commits and complete base-inspiration recipes are excluded when alternatives exist.
batch_semantics.visibility: A candidate completed during a batch can affect only a later scheduling batch.

online_qd.block_repetition: All non-random configured treatment settings were held fixed across paired blocks; the explicit seed derivation above supplied distinct block-specific stochastic states.
